comments.text:
The storytelling script has very little connection to the sequences shown in the video. For viewers who don't already know Bangladesh in detail, this could convey a wrong message. Much valuable information is completely mismatched with the visuals, which is deeply disappointing. The video editing is poor. Because of this careless editing and incoherent storytelling, many people may form a negative impression of our rich and beautiful Bangladesh.

I therefore strongly condemn the uploading of such an incoherent, immature and incomplete video to YouTube. I urge you to withdraw this video immediately, re-edit it with accurate and realistic visuals, and upload it again. I also request that the channel owner or management express regret and apologize for this, because our country's image is tied to this video.

I hope you will take this matter in a positive spirit.
